style: Satirical hand-painted digital illustration for an adult YouTube channel about money, in one consistent art style for the whole series: confident ink linework, painterly shading with visible brush texture, volumetric light, soft shadows. ONE consistent color grade for every scene: warm tungsten evening light with muted teal shadows, slightly desaturated. Extremely detailed lived-in everyday Russian student life (university canteen, student dormitory, small shop near the dorm): many small, carefully drawn, recognizable objects and textures — worn surfaces, stickers, cables, dishes, posters with no readable text. Expressive slightly grotesque faces, cinematic composition, vertical 9:16. Food is always served properly: soup in bowls, buckwheat and cutlets on plates, bread on a saucer — nothing lies loose directly on a tray or table. Not a kids cartoon, not glossy 3D, not flat vector. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks.
